notes: Your work now backs up safely. Your daily plan — including which items you've checked off — is saved to the cloud and comes back on its own if you reinstall, clear the app, or switch devices. No more lost daily progress. Truck inventory, Min/Max, and shop quantities all back up and restore too, and an empty phone can never wipe your cloud inventory. Also: if you ever land on the 'ask the desk to switch you to the Parts role' screen by mistake, there's now a one-tap 'Switch back to Field Tech' button.
